Ligi do końca sezonu 2027/2028 |url=https://www.1liga.org/w/betclic-sponsorem-tytularnym-1.-ligi-do-końca-sezonu-2027/2028 |publisher=[[I liga]] |access-date=20 June 2024 |language=pl |date=20 June 2024}} is the 79th season of [[Sports league|the second tier domestic division]] in the [[Polish football league system]] since its establishment in 1949 and the 19th season of the Polish [[I liga]] under its current title. The league is operated by the [[Polish Football Association|PZPN]]. ==Season overview== The season started on 24 July 2026 and will go into the winter break after the 18th matchday on 12 December. With the 19th matchday, the season will continue on 6 February 2027. The final 34th matchday is scheduled for 29 May 2027.{{Cite web|url=https://www.1liga.org/w/ramowy-terminarz-betclic-1-ligi-na-sezon-2026/2027|title=Ramowy terminarz Betclic 1 Ligi na sezon 2026/2027|publisher=1liga.org|date=23 April 2026|access-date=7 July 2026}} The regular season is being played as a [[round-robin tournament]]. A total of 18 teams participate, 12 of which competed in the league campaign during the [[2025–26 I liga|previous season]], while three to be relegated from the [[2025–26 Ekstraklasa]] and the remaining three to be promoted from the [[2025–26 II liga]]. Each team will play a total of 34 matches, half at home and half away. ==Teams== A total of 18 teams will participate in the 2026–27 edition of the I liga. ===Changes from last season=== The following teams have changed division since the [[2025–26 I liga|2025–26 season]]. {{col-begin|width=90%}} {{col-2}} ====To I liga==== {| class="wikitable" |- !
